If that vendor's selected units >= tier_units, apply its tier_bps discount to the entire gross; round the vendor's merchandise total to cents, with exact halves rounded up. Add shipping_cents unless the PRE-DISCOUNT gross >= free_shipping_gross. Subtract rebate_cents only if at least two different SKUs are selected from that vendor AND the POST-DISCOUNT merchandise total >= rebate_merchandise_min. All thresholds are inclusive.
